recipe.visualDefinition: A side-profile portrait of a man in a tall fur hat and tan coat smoking a pipe, set against a high-key, overexposed winter landscape. The composition is anchored by a dense block of right-aligned, tightly tracked serif typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark, textured fur hat and the blown-out white sky
Vertical alignment between the subject's back and the right-justified text block
Warm tones of the coat against the cool, desaturated winter background
coreInvariants: High-key, overexposed background with faint tree silhouettes
Extreme tight kerning with overlapping characters in the display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up in profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the fur hat provides the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face/pipe, moves up to the hat, then across to the dense text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive overexposed white space in the upper left and center background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme negative tracking causing character overlaps
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tight, high-contrast 70s serif aesthetic.
Classic skeleton that matches the era when tracked tightly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in profile facing left, wearing a tall black fur ushanka hat and a tan winter coat, smoking a wooden pipe. The background is a bright, overexposed winter scene with faint, blurry bare trees and a white sky. Soft natural lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned uppercase serif text in the upper right corner. Use extreme negative tracking so letters touch and overlap. The top two lines should be largest, followed by a list of smaller text lines below.

verificationChecks: Do the letters in the display text overlap?
Is the subject in a clear profile view?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pipe is visible in the profile silhouette.
Check that the fur texture of the hat is distinct against the white background.
Verify the text does not touch the subject's head.
Confirm the background trees are desaturated and hazy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile subject + High-key winter background + Right-aligned overlapping serif typography = Classic Soul Editorial Style.
